hedging_delta.evidence: Similar level of standard forward-looking disclaimers and confident phrasing like 'we expect' in both calls.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Q2 revenue growth of 45-50% (~$64.7M midpoint) and EPS $0.25-$0.31; current guides Q3 to $77-79M and EPS $0.67-$0.75, well above prior trajectory.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: Timing market TAM cited as $10 billion prior call, now $11 billion current call.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New emphasis on robotaxis, warehouse robots, NATO defense spending, and follow-on equity offering not discussed in prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Both calls use superlatives, but current adds 'phenomenal job,' 'exceptional quarter,' and highlights bookings/funnel strength more than prior.

demand_language_delta.evidence: CED grew 198% YoY prior call vs 137% YoY current call, a deceleration despite still-strong absolute growth.
